div.span: type: majority vote of the reports (event_typing.py); a commander's type stands
witnesses: effective independent reporters (corroboration.py)
place: reverse geocode of the centroid → district
weather: this hazard's own variable from a METAR within 50 km, else Open-Meteo, over the observed span ± 3 h (rain and flood: 24 h)
official warning: a SACHET polygon or the named district
news: 2+ publishers 0.75 · one 0.55
receipt v2: 7 weighted factors; vision and anomaly are offline for good, so factor_coverage is 0.80
severity = max(content axis: depth and hazard rules, count axis)

severity = max(content axis: depth and hazard rules, count axis)
